instructions_by_domain.travel: Track intent and persistent preferences. Context is all user messages, API history plus new_message, or previous_beliefs plus new_message; treat them equivalently. Intent: book_flight (find or book a flight); book_hotel (find or book a hotel); unknown (another request). Return intent probabilities summing to 1 and independent probabilities for budget_sensitive (the traveler currently prioritizes low prices); prefers_direct (the traveler currently prefers nonstop flights). Keep intent across task follow-ups and preference/constraint/permission updates, even without a task verb. Switch for a new task. Use unknown for unrelated requests or explicit pause/cancellation. Preferences persist across tasks; latest explicit changes, negations and reversals win. Use supplied context only. Return schema JSON.

methodology: Synthetic labeled conversations; identical domain instructions/schema across paths. Full history resends user messages only; provider history retains model outputs too. Snapshot sends only BeliefRuntime state and latest message. Every creation/update call counted. Latency includes response body, parsing and runtime infer merge, excludes local snapshot load/save and report writes. Serial calls, rotating workflow order, no retries, 120s request timeout. Cache reads/writes are disjoint subsets of input; absent cache fields treated as zero. Cost uses explicit supplied rates only; excludes storage, serialization, taxes and failed/unreported calls. Partial reports must not be used for workflow comparisons.
